title: Battle Outcome (Payload)
description: The full result of one battle simulation. Currently returned by POST /battle/simulate but NOT persisted. Proposed storage inside battle_result.payload. Contains winner, round count, and the full event stream for replay.

winner.description: A = yourSquad wins, B = opponentSquad wins.

rounds.description: Number of rounds played. Max is MAX_ROUNDS + 1 (timeout round).

seed.description: The seed used for this battle, as a string (BigInt serialized). Same seed + same squads = identical outcome.

events.description: Full event stream for replay. Starts with battleStart, ends with victory.
